findings.title: Area Basis enum capitalization mismatch
findings.description: User specified lowercase values ('Carpet area', 'Rare carpet', 'Built up', 'Super built up'), but code uses title case ('Carpet Area', 'Rare Carpet', 'Built Up', 'Super Built Up'). This is a minor visual/naming inconsistency with no functional impact. Confirm if title case is intended or should match user spec exactly.
